Sample.evidence_source: The mean age of participants was 14.9 years (range 13–16, SD = .79), 18 (56%) were male, 11 (34%) were Maori, 12 (38%) were Pacific island, 8 (25%) were New Zealand European and 1 was of other ethnicity.

dxgive.evidence_source: All participants had a CDRS-R score of over the 70th percentile of depressive symptoms as detailed in the CDRS-R manual (Poznanski and Mokros, 1996).
